Constructor deploy history stores prior real operator even after retirement/death, excludes enemy/token/device births and failed placements. Native CardBuff manager/lifeType numeric dispatcher is not certified.
runtimeMapping.talent1: E1/E2 selected .5/.8 current ATK as True per victim, original x-5/WALK purposeDAMAGE excludes air/target-free/stealth/sleep. Eventless native birth ability is mapped at successful operator birth (useRealBornTimeFromAnim0), not inferred from absent Start event.
runtimeMapping.talent2: Original E2 attr17 formulaADDITION with selected .20/.23 def_penetrate maps persistent physical DEF-ignore; does not alter True damage or ally stats.
runtimeMapping.s1: All ten ranks use selected permanent ATK/ASPD, source range2-2, original Skill_1_Begin.1 idle mix then Skill_1_Idle/Loop.467 and literal Down override; no manual off toggle.
runtimeMapping.s2: Selected passive OccupyZero and in-deck dontOccupyDeployCnt1 support exemption only when skchr_nearl2_2 selected. Native finite20..27s ATK60..160%, two..four BlockDamage shield layers, no damage/applyWay filters; HP loss/gauge bypass existing ordinary barrier path. Source skill end creates ratio CardBuff UNTIL_NEXT_SPAWN then Withdraw. Adapter applies selected1.25 or combo1 once to actual final redeployment cooldown on duration completion; fresh Unit after next successful placement consumes it. Auto Withdraw uses original character refund.5 of actual paid deployment cost.
runtimeMapping.sun: Source original zero-slot category1 ground summon, no attack, HP6000/block2/RES20/phase DEF422..600 at source owner elite+level without trust/potential transfer, fixed direction. Native HealFreeflag7 and HP/SPregen multipliers0; no ordinary heal/regen. Original useRealBornTimeFromAnim1 maps exact Start.333 then eventless hidden birth True burst in x-5/WALK; previous real operator sampled at this mapped birth phase. Owner current ATK times selected token rank coefficient follows original S3 operator text and explicit combo baseOnHostAtk1; raw tokenATK10 is preserved and not falsely transferred as ordinary stat.
runtimeMapping.s3: Selected25s ATK40..140%/DEF20..100%/range2-1. Source TileSelector filter11/alwaysRandomInTheEnd1 maps seeded eligible free adjacent ground tile, no guessed enemy/facing preference and no fallback blast without token. Native Skill_3/.5/Down variant one current ground victim; exact source template selects True only for own operator or own living Sun blocker, Physical for unblocked/another ally blocker. Skill finish/owner death removes only owned Sun; born token death interrupts its future birth phase. Hidden skill canUseInAbnormalState0 rejects a token still unable to act at the mapped birth phase.

verificationLimits: Native executable C# card/ability/FSM/selector dispatch is not recovered. All five original bundle sizes/MD5/SHA and exact referenced skeleton bytes are retained, but no recorded-client frame parity is claimed.

Operator T1, S1/S3 BuffAttack, Sword SpawnToken and Sun hidden skill all waitForAttackEvent1 with empty animation keys. Original operator Start and token Start have no attack events. The adapter explicitly uses text-bound successful operator birth, activation and token real Start completion phases; it does not manufacture an original OnAttack event.

Native S3 TileSelector filterType11 preference is unrecovered. Seeded choice among free deployable adjacent ground tiles preserves final random field but does not claim native enemy priority, sorting or probability distribution.

Native CardBuff categoryMask639/manageType1/lifeType2 and CheckContainsCardBuff ordering are not executable. Previous-successful-operator history is primary-description backed. Sun real birth timing versus immediate card consumption and intervening deployment remains the chosen explicit birth-phase interpretation.

Sun main native owner-stat inheritance is not recovered from raw ATK10. Exact combo AdvancedApplyDamage baseOnHostAtk1 and original S3 owner description support current owner ATK for both birth hits; numerical transfer/current sampling remains a declared bridge, not direct executable proof. Token trust/owner potential modifiers do not transfer to its defenses.

S2 UNTIL_NEXT_SPAWN auto-duration cooldown ratio is source/description bound. Native buff-finish reentry on manual retreat/death and full card lifetime dispatcher are unrecovered; adapter applies no auto-duration penalty on early manual retreat/death. Ordinary fresh-unit redeploy creates no persistent ratio stacking and no card-cost changes.

Native active combo and Stun application versus base MeleeAttack ordering is unrecovered. Two equal separately notified True hits followed by source stun is the chosen birth-family mapping; canceled first hit does not establish native combo suppression parity.

Native hidden Sun skill canUseInAbnormalState0 is preserved by rejecting an actor still stunned at the mapped Start completion. Executable interrupted-birth retry/queue semantics are not recovered, so no invented later retry is scheduled.

Original Start/Skill2Die birth/removal FSM, literal directional mixes, particles/audio and Sun light geometry are not fully reproduced. Original skeleton aliases/timings are used, and compact feedback is approximate.
